user.title: Amazon Thermostat
user.description: Choose your Amazon region and authentication method. Guided Amazon login is recommended.

cookie2_credentials.title: Amazon login
cookie2_credentials.description: The next step opens a temporary login proxy that runs on its own port (Homebridge alexa-cookie2 style). Set the proxy port and open the proxy URL from a browser on a device WITHOUT the Alexa app installed.

alexapy_credentials.title: Fallback Amazon login
alexapy_credentials.description: Confirm the Home Assistant callback URLs. The next step opens an Amazon login page using the fallback alexapy flow.

manual.title: Advanced manual authentication
manual.description: Paste an Alexa web cookie header and matching CSRF token. Use this only if guided login is unavailable.

check_proxy.title: Complete Amazon login
check_proxy.description: Sign in to Amazon in the opened window. Return here after the login page says it is complete.

finish_proxy.title: Finishing Amazon login
finish_proxy.description: Validating Amazon login and discovering thermostats.

error.alexapy_not_installed: The alexapy dependency is not installed.
error.invalid_url: The Home Assistant URL is invalid.
error.proxy_port_in_use: The login proxy port is already in use. Choose a different port.
